name: rad-brainstorm
description: Anti-anchoring brainstorming for Codex. It draws out the user's thinking before adding ideas, keeps generation separate from evaluation, and supports quick sessions, full sessions, root-cause analysis, idea evaluation, and software design sprints.

interface.shortDescription: Think first, then build better ideas with Codex.
interface.longDescription: RAD Brainstorm helps users explore ideas without anchoring them on an AI-generated list. It asks for the user's thinking first, separates idea generation from evaluation, and scales from a quick bounded pass to a full facilitated session. It also includes Five Whys root-cause analysis, structured idea evaluation, and software design sprints. It never implements application code.
defaultPrompt: Run a quick brainstorm on this topic.
Help me explore this idea without anchoring me on your answers.
Use Five Whys to find the root cause of this problem.
Help me compare these ideas before I choose one.
Turn this chosen software idea into a reviewable design spec.
